mapper.select: SELECT id, tenant_id, owner_id, device_id, state, sources_json, checks_json, false AS expired, to_char(expires_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC','YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.MS"Z"') AS expires_at FROM c2k_runtime_readiness WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND device_id=#{deviceId} AND state IN ('PENDING','CHECKING') AND expires_at > clock_timestamp() ORDER BY expires_at LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE c2k_runtime_readiness SET state='CHECKING' WHERE id=#{id} AND state='PENDING' AND expires_at > clock_timestamp()
